Dialogs.Dialog: (What should I do？ Call out to her？)
Oh, so you did hear me.
(Couldn't she talk to me a little more normally...)
You could at least say hi.
I don't have to say hi, do I？
Something... Everyone keeps saying my attitude's bad, I'm cheeky... Borrow your book quietly and leave quietly, geez.
You can't borrow a book without saying anything, though.
(Better not poke the bear right now.)
(Um. What do I do with this again？)
Hey. What do I do with this again？
(Curt as ever, but she does teach me.)
(I can figure it out myself if I look it up. Whatever.)
(Huh, was that ▲小早川＊▲ who just turned the corner？)
She went this way, I think...
No, no, that's not it. It was just sudden...
Oh, I see, that's why I didn't see you.
What are you, in grade school？
What's up？ Going to the arcade again？
Don't make me sound so predictable.
I'm going. Don't you have stuff to do too？
What are you, in grade school？
You look as bored as ever.
(...Come to think of it, ▲小早川＊▲ talked to me first.)
(Um. Does this book go on this shelf...)
What are you, in grade school？
(Read for once, or head home early？)
(All right, for once I'll read, like a proper library committee member.)
What are you, in grade school？
What are you doing？ Reading？ Napping？
Sorry to interrupt when you're so busy, but I'm heading home, so lock up.
What are you, in grade school？
Where are you going？ Class is starting.
(I need to go to the staff room...)
What are you, in grade school？
No, I'm just going the same way.
Oops, sorry. I talked too long. What did you need？
I can always spot you, even from far away.
Oops. Did I keep you standing here talking？
Not at all. I wanted to talk more.
Okay, let's get them put away.
Geez, who keeps using the stepladder and not putting it back？ Think about the short people...
Ow！ I helped you, didn't I!?
That bugged me, so I kicked you, just because. But thanks, just because.
Hey, want to skip committee today？ Let's go to the arcade or something.
Hey now, lots of work is no excuse. It'll cause trouble for everyone, right？
Huh, I didn't mean it like...
Phew, done... Oh right, the teacher wanted to see me.
Then I've got business in the staff room.
Oh, there's the bell. Head back to class.
▲小早川＊▲？ What are you doing here？
What do you mean？ You were asleep and didn't even notice Rinko in the hallway.
If you needed me, you could've called me.
Maybe Rinko will just take class here in this room.
Nah, I was just thinking nobody's around.
Nah, I was just thinking nobody's around.
Nah, I was just thinking nobody's around.
Just so you know, this time's special... Got it？
Don't worry about it, don't worry about it.
Can't hear you, can't hear you.
Geez... This is school, you know？
